The subject resembles a slow worm or glass lizard more than a thunder snake due to the pointed head, visible eyes, ridged scales, and tapered tail. This is a significant semantic alignment error despite the classifier's confidence.

Since these are coherent textures and shapes (just wrong for the class), they are penalized heavily in alignment but less so in artifact score, resulting in a high artifact score (clean image) but low alignment score (wrong object details).
